SELECT id, avatar_pic, tutor_name, tutor_profile, experience, label, configuration_json FROM tutor_info
is_enabled=#{param.isEnabled} and
domain_type=#{param.domainType} and
private_invitation_code=#{param.privateInvitationCode} and
JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 0, "isEnabled": true}', '$')
( JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 1, "isEnabled": true}', '$') OR JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 2, "isEnabled": true}', '$') OR JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 3, "isEnabled": true}', '$') OR JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 4, "isEnabled": true}', '$') OR JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 5, "isEnabled": true}', '$') OR JSON_CONTAINS(configuration_json, '{"itemType": 6, "isEnabled": true}', '$') )
order by sort asc

SELECT tutorInfo.*,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.user_id END) AS current_follow_users,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN followRecord.follow_status != 2 THEN followRecord.current_follow_sum END), 0) AS current_follow_sum,
COUNT(DISTINCT followRecord.user_id) AS total_follow_users,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.initial_follow_sum), 0) AS total_initial_sum,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.return_follow_sum), 0) AS total_return_sum,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.tutor_commission), 0) AS total_tutor_commission,
COALESCE(SUM(followRecord.platform_commission), 0) AS total_platform_commission FROM tutor_info tutorInfo LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record followRecord ON tutorInfo.id = followRecord.tutor_id
AND followRecord.follow_start_time >= #{param.startTime}
AND followRecord.follow_start_time <= #{param.endTime}
tutorInfo.id = #{param.tutorId} and
GROUP BY tutorInfo.id
